submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for the current token belonging to a V-centered embedding neighborhood: it fires maximally on the bare uppercase-'V' subword whether word-initial (VASCO, VACATED, VES, VIDEO, Voir, Vine) or word-medial (SEVERE, NanoVic, ITV, GAINESVILLE, XXVIII, VUV), strongly on the spaced variant ' V' and V/X Roman numerals (XV, XII, VIII, III, IX), and moderately on travel/tourism and French place/name words (travel(ers), luggage, voyage, guide, France, Paris, Vu, Madame, Monsieur); it stays near zero on function words, digits, other single capitals (B/C/D/K/M/Q) and unrelated nouns (hotel, train, car, Smith, victory, very). Firing is context-independent, determined by the current token alone.

!     driver routine for nsl 1d complex fft's of length nz
!     ldz >= nz is the distance between sequences to be transformed
!     (ldz>nz is used on some architectures to reduce memory conflicts)

     INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: isign
     INTEGER, INTENT(IN) :: nsl, nz, ldz

     COMPLEX (DP) :: c(:), cout(:)

     INTEGER    :: i, err, idir, ip, void

     INTEGER, SAVE :: icurrent = 1
     LOGICAL :: found
